thesaurus.definition: a gum used in pharmacy, adhesives, and textile printing

wiktionary.gloss: A polysaccharide gum, extracted from several species of leguminous plants of the genus Astragalus, formerly used medicinally and now as a food additive. Also more fully gum tragacanth.
